hero.headline: Argued on the record,
hero.summary: Chambers of Vimal Vasireddy appears in constitutional, commercial and appellate matters before the High Court for the State of Telangana and in domestic and institutional arbitration.
hero.note: Instructions received through an instructing advocate. Juniors of these chambers may be instructed directly.

profile.title: Preparation is the argument.
profile.body: A short account of the advocate's practice and approach will be added once approved by him. Everything on this page is placeholder copy written by the web team and carries no factual weight until he has confirmed it.
profile.recordNote: Particulars are published under the proviso to Rule 36 of the Bar Council of India Rules.

credentials.label: Courts admitted
credentials.value: Telangana High Court, AP High Court & NCLT

practiceAreas.title: Constitutional Law
practiceAreas.short: Writ jurisdiction and fundamental-rights petitions before the High Court.
practiceAreas.detail: Petitions under Articles 226 and 32, challenges to statutory and executive action, and matters raising questions of fundamental rights. Work in this area turns on framing the question precisely and building a record that survives scrutiny.

practiceAreas.title: Arbitration
practiceAreas.short: Domestic and institutional arbitration, from appointment through enforcement.
practiceAreas.detail: Appointment applications, interim measures, conduct of arbitral proceedings, and challenges to and enforcement of awards under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.

practiceAreas.title: Criminal Appellate
practiceAreas.short: Appellate and revisional work, and matters of bail before the High Court.
practiceAreas.detail: Appeals, revisions and applications for bail, with attention to the trial record and to the legal questions that appellate courts are actually able to reach.

practiceAreas.title: Civil Appellate
practiceAreas.short: First and second appeals in property, contract and injunction matters.
practiceAreas.detail: Appellate work arising from civil suits, including questions of title, contractual construction, and the scope of injunctive relief.

practiceAreas.title: Company & Commercial
practiceAreas.short: Company disputes, regulatory proceedings and commercial matters.
practiceAreas.detail: Disputes before the company and commercial jurisdictions, regulatory proceedings, and matters arising from shareholder and commercial arrangements.

practiceAreas.title: Service & Regulatory
practiceAreas.short: Service jurisprudence and proceedings before statutory authorities.
practiceAreas.detail: Matters concerning conditions of service, disciplinary proceedings, and challenges to the orders of statutory and regulatory authorities.

approach.title: The record first, then the argument.
approach.intro: Placeholder copy. The advocate's own account of how these chambers prepare a matter will replace this text once he has approved it.

principles.title: Begin with the record
principles.body: The pleadings, orders and documents establish what can actually be argued. The record is settled before the strategy is.

principles.title: Frame the question
principles.body: Appellate and constitutional courts reach the questions that are put to them precisely. Framing is most of the work.

principles.title: Argue what will decide it
principles.body: A shorter argument that meets the point tends to travel further than a longer one that covers everything.

contactBand.title: Two routes, and they are not interchangeable.
contactBand.body: Briefing the Senior Advocate is done through an instructing advocate. The juniors of these chambers practise independently and may be instructed directly.

separationNotice: Vimal Vasireddy is a Senior Advocate designated under Section 16 of the Advocates Act, 1961, and does not accept briefs or instructions directly from clients. Instructions must be received through an instructing advocate. For availability and dates, please contact the chambers clerk.
